entries.label: t07_01
entries.text: Welcome to Zapapico! It’s a mining town, full of\nhardworking folks.

entries.label: t07_06
entries.text: Sure, big cities are fun to go visit, but plain little\ntowns like this one have their own charm!

entries.label: t07_07
entries.text: The name Zapapico comes from a word for a\npickaxe. Fitting for a town of mostly miners, no?

entries.label: t07_09
entries.text: Nothing like finding a bench when you really\nneed one! You’ll understand when you’re older.

entries.label: t07_11
entries.text: I saw this Pokémon in the mine that was so big,\nit was like a mountain!

entries.label: t07_12
entries.text: Well, I saw a Pokémon so long it was like a river!

entries.label: t07_16
entries.text: Phanpy’s a Ground type! It’s resistant to poison,\nand it shrugs off electricity altogether!\c\nJust, um, don’t pour water on it.

entries.label: t07_31
entries.text: My buddies and I battle our Pokémon on that\ncourt on our way home from work.

entries.label: t07_36
entries.text:
My job would be a lot harder without my dear
Carkol around!\c
By that, I mean it provides moral support, not
just manual labor...although it helps with that too.

entries.label: t07_42
entries.text: Once, I was on the verge of fainting a little ways\noutside town, when a wild Pokémon Center lady\r\nappeared and came to my rescue!

entries.label: t07_taxi
entries.text:
Flying Taxi here! Take a ride through the sky,
powered by Squawkabilly!\c
Need a lift? Just open your map app and give us
a call. We’ll pick you up practically anywhere!
